messages.subject: Brampton v Hartwell - draft Particulars of Claim for settling
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Catherine, Harriet,

Please find our draft Particulars of Claim (v1) for settling. We've pleaded the full £3,419,600 with the Scott Schedule and Schedule of Loss to be served alongside. Grateful for your mark-up - in particular we wondered whether to particularise the EHO closure dates and the interest rate in the prayer.

Kind regards,

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Catherine has settled the Particulars - mark-up attached. We've added the EHO closure dates (10 May, 14 June, 19 August), noted that PC was about two weeks late, and pleaded interest at 4% over base in the prayer. Otherwise content. Happy for these to be issued.

Harriet
